title: Fourier expansion of the mod-three indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The function equal to $1$ when the integer sum of the coordinates of $x$ is divisible by $3$, and to $0$ otherwise, is the multilinear polynomial whose coefficient at a subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ is $1/3$ when $S$ is empty, plus $\frac{2}{3}(-1/2)^n(-1)^{(|S|\bmod 4)/2}(\sqrt{3})^{|S|}$ when $|S|$ is even; this additional contribution is zero when $|S|$ is odd.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
